#raster 1:basic terra operation

if (!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")
## Loading required package: pacman
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,
               terra,
               tidyterra,
               mapview,
               stars)

#rast is a function to read data from your directory
(spr_ex<-rast("data/spr_example.tif"))
## class       : SpatRaster
## size        : 90, 95, 1  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
## resolution  : 0.008333333, 0.008333333  (x, y)
## extent      : 5.741667, 6.533333, 49.44167, 50.19167  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
## coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
## source      : spr_example.tif
## name        : elevation
## min value   :       141
## max value   :       547
writeRaster (x=spr_ex,filename="data/spr_elev.tif",overwrite=TRUE)

ggplot()+geom_spatraster(data=spr_ex)

star_ex <- st_as_stars(spr_ex) 
mapview(star_ex)
v_elev<-values(spr_ex)

extract(spr_ex,y=cbind(6.0000,50.0000))
##   elevation
## 1       406
extract(spr_ex,y=cbind(25.00,5.00))
##   elevation
## 1        NA
extract (spr_ex,y=cbind(10.000,15.000))
##   elevation
## 1        NA
extract(spr_ex,y=cbind(300.00,200.00))
##   elevation
## 1        NA
df_point<-tibble(lon=c(6,5.9),lat=c(50,49.96))

extract(spr_ex,y=df_point)
##   ID elevation
## 1  1       406
## 2  2       345
spr_for<-rast("data/spr_forest_nc.tif")

ggplot()+geom_spatraster(data=spr_for)
## <SpatRaster> resampled to 500480 cells.

unique(spr_for) 
##   forest
## 1      0
## 2      1
v_binary <- values(spr_for) 
mean (v_binary)*100 
## [1] 68.42346
spr_land <- rast("data/spr_land_reclass.tif")
unique(spr_land)
##   code
## 1    0
## 2 1001
## 3 1010
## 4 1100
extract(spr_land,y=cbind(-79.8063,36.0701))
##   code
## 1 1100
cm<-cbind(c(0,1001,1010,1100),c(0,1,0,0))
 
spr_bin <- classify(spr_land,rcl=cm) 

unique(spr_bin)
##   code
## 1    0
## 2    1
v_bin<-values(spr_bin) 
mean(v_bin)*100
## [1] 68.42346
cm_crop<-cbind(c(0,1001,1010,1100),c(0,0,1.0))
## Warning in cbind(c(0, 1001, 1010, 1100), c(0, 0, 1)): number of rows of result
## is not a multiple of vector length (arg 2)
classify(x=spr_land,rcl=cm_crop)
## class       : SpatRaster
## size        : 2729, 8938, 1  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
## resolution  : 0.0009920635, 0.0009920635  (x, y)
## extent      : -84.32341, -75.45635, 33.88194, 36.58929  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
## coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
## source(s)   : memory
## varname     : spr_land_reclass
## name        : code
## min value   :    0
## max value   :    1
spr_crop<-classify(x=spr_land,rcl=cm_crop)

v_crop<-values(spr_crop) 
mean(v_crop)*100
## [1] 9.061598
cm_urban<-cbind(c(0,1001,1010,1100),c(0,0,0,1))

spr_urban<-classify(spr_land,rcl=cm_urban)


unique(spr_urban) 
##   code
## 1    0
## 2    1
v_urban<-values(spr_urban)
mean(v_urban) *100
## [1] 3.169528

spr_prec_ncne <- rast("data/spr_prec_ncne.tif")

#Q2
#long extent = -79.89181,-75.45847 #1at extent = 35.24153,36.59153
#CRS " WGS84 #min max precipitation = 1063.1-1501
                    
#Q3 
ggplot()+geom_spatraster(data=spr_prec_ncne)

sf_site <- readRDS("data/sf_finsync_nc.rds")

df_xy <- st_coordinates(sf_site) 

df_land<-extract(spr_land,
                   df_xy)


#forest 
df_land%>%
  filter(code==1001) %>% 
  nrow()
## [1] 111
#cropland
df_land %>% 
  filter(code==1010) %>% 
  nrow()
## [1] 2
#urban 
df_land%>% 
  filter(code==1100) %>% 
  nrow()
## [1] 9
#quicker approach
table(df_land)
## code
## 1001 1010 1100 
##  111    2    9
